title: pseudoryza ciliata
intro: Pseudoryza ciliata, commonly known as Chinese angelica, is a plant species used in traditional Chinese medicine. This plant is known for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties that help to reduce fever, alleviate pain, and protect against infections. The therapeutic actions of Pseudoryza ciliata include its ability to regulate menstrual cycles, reduce blood pressure, and boost the immune system. The bioactive constituents of this plant include coumarins, lignans, and flavonoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
